sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

sections.heading: Beginner Tips and Tricks
sections.body:
For beginners, Zombie Apocalypse Tunnel Survival can be a challenging and intimidating game. Here are a few tips and tricks to help new players get started and improve their chances of survival.

First, it's essential to scavenge for resources and craft equipment quickly. This will give you the tools you need to take down zombies and survive. Focus on collecting wood, metal, and food, and use these resources to craft new equipment and upgrade your existing gear.

Second, it's crucial to choose the right equipment for the job. Different zombies have different weaknesses and resistances, so it's essential to choose the right gun and ammo to take them down. For example, some zombies are resistant to bullets, so you'll need to use melee attacks to take them down.

Third, pay attention to your surroundings and use your environment to your advantage. Look for pitfalls and lava pits to take down zombies, and use cover to avoid taking damage. Finally, don't be afraid to run away and escape danger if necessary. It's better to live to fight another day than to die trying to take on too many zombies at once.

By following these tips and tricks, beginners can improve their chances of survival and have a more enjoyable experience in Zombie Apocalypse Tunnel Survival.
